messages:
Alex: Hey all, trying to finish my dev setup and Homebrew postinstall keeps asking for admin password. MDM shows the device as "enrolled" but I don't have admin rights. Can someone grant a one-time sudo or suggest a safe workaround? 
Jordan (IT): @Alex, welcome! Can you paste the last prompt text? Also send your serial (or run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial` and paste).
Alex: Prompt says: 'The install requires a system administrator to approve.' Here’s serial: C02ABC1234JX.
MDM-Bot: Device C02ABC1234JX enrolled (profile: Standard-User). No admin group assigned. Last check-in: 2026-02-18T09:12:03Z.
Jordan (IT): Thanks. Looks like enrollment applied the standard profile (no admin). Two options: 1) we can push a temporary admin profile (expires in 24h) via MDM, or 2) if you prefer, run the specific commands as IT during a Zoom screen-share so we don't add admin privs permanently. Which do you prefer?
Alex: Temporary admin for 1 hour would be ideal. I’m online now.
Toni: +1 for temp admin. Saves time for both.
Jordan (IT): Cool. I'll push a temp-admin profile now. You should get a prompt to accept a configuration change. After acceptance, add yourself to admin with this command (once):
```
sudo dseditgroup -o edit -a alex -t user admin
```
Jordan (IT): After you confirm Homebrew installed, reply here and I'll remove the admin binding. Note: if FileVault is enabled we also need the recovery key stored — can you check in Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault?
Alex: FileVault shows as enabled. Recovery key: company escrowed (OK).
Sam: If you run into permission errors for /usr/local, try `sudo chown -R $(whoami) /usr/local` after we finish.
Alex: Got the temp admin prompt, accepted. Ran the dseditgroup command, brew installer proceeded. All set! Installed zsh, git, node.
Jordan (IT): Great. I'm removing the admin binding now.
MDM-Bot: Profile update: temp-admin removed for C02ABC1234JX (action performed by Jordan (IT)).
Alex: Confirmed I no longer have admin. Everything looks good. Thanks everyone :tada:
Toni: Welcome aboard!! If you need dotfiles or dev container tips ping me.
Jordan (IT): Closing loop — logged ticket #IT-4821 for the temp admin action and FV verification. If anything pops up re-open this thread.
Alex: Thanks, everyone. Appreciate the quick help!
